title.zh: WisdomTree Opens Tokenized Treasury Fund To MoonPay's 35 Million Accounts

current_state.zh: WisdomTree is opening its $1.23 billion tokenized Treasury fund WTGXX to MoonPay's 35 million accounts, with MoonPay holding the fund against its stablecoin reserves.
